record.what_it_does: CRM platform for sales, marketing, service and CMS, with a broad public API.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 is required for apps installed in multiple accounts, and it is the only auth method allowed for Marketplace-listed apps. Static auth access tokens (formerly private-app tokens) and service keys are single-account Bearer tokens. A developer API key is used only for some app features and settings. Client-credentials tokens (an OAuth grant) are used for the webhooks journal API. The HubSpot CLI creates a personal access key for local development.
record.access_notes: Building and testing is self-serve: HubSpot accounts are free, and developer test accounts are free with a 90-day trial of many enterprise features. Distribution is gated. Static-token apps install in 1 standard account. Private OAuth apps install in up to 10 allowlisted accounts. Marketplace-distribution OAuth apps on platform 2025.2 (since September 22, 2025) are capped at 25 installs until the HubSpot Ecosystem Quality team reviews and lists the app. Listing requires at least 3 active, unique installs, OAuth as the sole auth method, and a manual review (initial review within 10 business days). AI connectors must require user-level permissions or be built with HubSpot's MCP Server.
record.api_breadth_notes: Covers CRM objects (contacts, companies, deals, tickets, custom objects), associations, search, engagements, pipelines and properties, plus marketing, CMS, conversations, webhooks and more. Well over 50 operations, but I did not count them exactly.
record.mcp_notes: Remote server: https://mcp.hubspot.com. It uses OAuth 2.0 through a user-level app. It gives read and write access to CRM objects such as contacts, companies and deals, and read-only access to some other content. Custom sensitive-data properties are excluded. HubSpot also publishes a local Developer MCP server through the HubSpot CLI (`hs mcp setup`, requires Developer Platform 2025.2).
record.blocker_notes: OAuth app creation and testing are self-serve. A multi-tenant toolkit, however, is capped at 25 installs until it passes HubSpot Marketplace review and is listed. Listing also requires 3 active, unaffiliated installs and imposes AI-connector rules (user-level permissions or HubSpot's MCP Server).
